items.briefing:
Australian small businesses are being increasingly targeted by AI-generated scams that are harder to spot because they appear personalised and convincing. Separately, the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) has issued a warning that JetBrains TeamCity servers are being actively exploited in Australia right now — if your organisation uses this software for software development, ensure it is patched immediately.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected email or message that feels unusually personalised or urgent — even if it looks legitimate — verify the request through a separate, known contact method before clicking any links or sharing information.

featured.title: AI fuels targeted scams against Australian small firms
featured.summary: Targeted fraud is inflicting bigger losses on small firms as AI helps criminals forge convincing invoices and impersonations in Australia.
